transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ___, and I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um, what brings me in is that I'm having a lot of trouble at work. I work in meat processing, and I keep starting my tasks—like the sanitation steps, the batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork—but I somehow always leave out the last parts. 

It's really frustrating because I know my job depends on finishing them correctly, but I just... I keep missing the end of the process. I need to figure out why I can't just follow through and finish what I start.
Did you have similar trouble finishing tasks or staying focused when you were a child?

Yes, actually. My mom still has my old elementary school report cards, like from around fourth grade. They always said I was bright but that I needed constant reminders to actually finish my classwork and turn in my homework. I remember I'd understand the lessons fine, but I'd just miss chunks of the instructions unless the teacher was right there staying close to me. So, yeah, it's been an issue for a long time.
Do you also have trouble paying attention or following through on everyday tasks outside of work or school, like at home?

Um, I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed it being a big issue at home. I mean, I mostly just relax when I get off work, so there aren't a lot of big tasks I have to worry about finishing. Work is really where I notice it the most, because that's where I have strict procedures I'm supposed to be following.
Do you also have this same kind of trouble at home?

I think... wait, didn't you just ask me that? Like I was saying, I don't really notice it at home. When I'm off work, I'm just hanging out, so there's not really anything I have to follow through on. It's really just the paperwork and the steps at work that are causing me problems.
Did you ever have trouble learning to read, write, or do math in school?

No, I didn't really have any problems with that. Like I said, I understood the lessons fine, it was just the actual focusing and getting the work done that was hard. But reading and math and all that came pretty easily to me.
Do you have this same problem with finishing things or staying focused in other parts of your life, like at home or in social situations?

Um... didn't we just go over this? Like I said a couple of minutes ago, no, I don't really have that problem at home. I just relax when I get off work. And socially, no, I don't really have trouble staying focused when I'm just hanging out with people. It really is just at my job.
Did you ever have trouble learning to read, write, or do math in school?

Um... you literally just asked me that one, too. Are we going in circles? But no, like I just said a minute ago, I didn't have any trouble learning to read or write or do math. The subjects themselves were completely fine. It was just focusing on the work that was the issue.
